subject: LaunchForge grant match + tiered sweetener proposal
messages:
From: Sam Tran <sam.tran@launchforge.org>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Park <katie.park@kpstartup.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: LaunchForge cohort — question on promo stacking and grant match

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed by the latency numbers on ded. We run a 10-week accelerator (LaunchForge) and have a grant-match program: we can co-fund compute credits with our partners for a small set of startups. A few questions from procurement and the founders team: 

- Can Redwood stack a short-term promotional credit on top of a grant match? For example, a $10k LaunchForge grant + a $2k promo for first 30 days.
- Would stacking require a separate contract/addendum or can it be handled as a billing tag on a single account?
- Any constraints on converting promo credits to Reserved/Dedicated commitments if a startup wants to upgrade mid-cohort?

We have 8 startups in the next cohort who would be good fits and want to understand operational friction before we move to a pilot. I can share high-level usage estimates if helpful.

Best,
Sam
Sam Tran
Partnerships Lead | LaunchForge Accelerator
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Tran <sam.tran@launchforge.org>
Cc: Katie Park <katie.park@kpstartup.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchForge cohort — question on promo stacking and grant match

Hi Sam — great to hear from you. Short answers up front: yes, stacking is possible; it usually maps to two credit buckets (grant + promo) on the billing side, and we can support a smooth conversion path to Dedicated with a credit reconciliation step.

I attached a short note on a recommended approach and a usage estimate template if you want to run numbers (see attached: LaunchForge_MVP_usage_estimates.xlsx). High-level options we typically see:

1) Grant-match + time-limited promo (recommended for pilots)
   - Promo applied as a top-up credit on the same account; no separate legal addendum required if total value is within our promo approval thresholds (<= $5k per organization).
   - We tag promo credits with an expiration and a "no-escrow" flag.

2) Grant + sweetener with conversion pathway to Dedicated
   - If a startup converts to Dedicated during/after cohort, we credit any unused promo/grant proportionally toward the committed spend (subject to minimums).

3) Cohort bulk purchase (preferred for operational simplicity)
   - LaunchForge purchases a pooled prepay; we create sub-accounts for each startup and manage allocation. This reduces per-startup billing ops but requires a brief PO or SOW.

Next steps I propose: 
- If you can send a 1-pager with expected cohort volume (tokens per month or rough model mix), Lauren will run a quick cost model and recommend a promo top-up level.
- If the cohort will likely upgrade to Dedicated, Marissa can prep a template addendum that clarifies credit reconciliation and conversion rules.

I copied Lauren and Marissa — Lauren, can you run a ballpark for 8 startups using the attached template? Marissa, can you draft an addendum that handles credit conversion and limited promo stacking (<= $5k)?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if it's easier.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Tran <sam.tran@launchforge.org>, Katie Park <katie.park@kpstartup.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchForge cohort — question on promo stacking and grant match

Thanks Naomi — I pulled together a quick ballpark based on the attached usage template. Assumptions (very rough):
- 8 startups, average early-stage usage: 150k tokens/month generation + 25k embedding tokens/month each
- 10-week cohort (2.5 months) — sticky usage assumed at ~70% of peak for that period

Estimated gross consumption across cohort (2.5 months):
- Generation: ~3,000,000 tokens
- Embeddings: ~500,000 tokens

Cost (hosted API rates): generation $0.0008 / token equivalent; embeddings $0.0006 / unit -> ~ $2,800 total

Recommendation: 
- Offer LaunchForge a $3,000 promo per cohort (covers majority of early consumption) + allow the $10k grant to be applied as a separate bucket. Operationally we would: create one pooled account, apply two credit balances (grant bucket and promo bucket), and enable sub-account allocation.

Notes / constraints:
- That $3k promo exceeds the standard auto-approval threshold. Marissa — will need your sign-off (pricing exception) and confirmation on whether we can do $3k as a one-off promo for a partner program.
- If startups convert to Dedicated, we credit unused token value proportionally against committed spend; minimum Dedicated term is 3 months.

PRIORITY ATTACHMENTS: I exported the rough model to the sheet Naomi attached (saved as LaunchForge_MVP_usage_estimates.xlsx).

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Analyst | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Tran <sam.tran@launchforge.org>, Katie Park <katie.park@kpstartup.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchForge cohort — question on promo stacking and grant match

Hi all — thanks for the details. I reviewed Lauren's numbers and the ask. We can approve a $3k partner promo for LaunchForge as a one-time promotional sweetener under partner program exceptions, with the following guardrails: 

- Promo cap: $3,000 per cohort, single use per LaunchForge cohort.
- Promo expiry: 60 days from issuance.
- Conversion: Unused promo/grant funds can be applied toward Dedicated conversion credits, but we require a reconciliation export and a signed addendum. We'll include an explicit formula in the addendum: (unused_token_value * conversion_rate) => credit toward committed spend.
- Legal: No additional enterprise contract required for the promo itself; for pooled-prepay allocations or Dedicated conversion we will require a short SOW/PO.

I attached a draft of the proposed terms (proposed-sweetener-terms.pdf) and a small ops checklist for onboarding cohorts. Naomi — if you and Sam are aligned, I can route the promo approval through G/A and get the accounting notice placed (one business day).

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
